en: Ekakanipāta, Parosatavagga (The Chapter on One Hundred and Fifty)
5. The Jātaka of the Weak Wood "Much indeed is this wood in the forest that the wind breaks, being weak; [yet it does not break the strong]."
“If you are afraid of him, O Naga, you will surely become emaciated.
The Fifth Jātaka: The Story of the Weak Tree.
